name: Avanafil

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Evaluation of erectile dysfunction (ED) should include an appropriate medical assessment to identify potential underlying causes, as well as treatment options. Before prescribing avanafil, it is important to note the following: • Patients should not use avanafil if sexual activity is…

summary: Official drug warnings state that doctors should properly evaluate erectile dysfunction to find underlying causes before prescribing Avanafil, and patients must avoid the drug if sexual activity is not recommended [3]. In addition, a small computer model, rather than tests in people, evaluated safety scores for the drug [M]. This computer model gave Avanafil a high risk score of 66 for the liver, but a low risk score of 44 for the heart [M].
